notes.title: Dwarven Skykeep | Challenge Level Update
notes.content:
Welcome, magicians! 

We are back with another major update for [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b]! Dwarves were toiling hard to bring you new content and a load of changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35159696/bd9ec3f60b3007031e828ecdd0a5eabef7d83688.jpg[/img]

This is the full changelog for the update:

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New challenge mode added: each of the five worlds now has a challenge level with greatly increased difficulty which is unlocked upon completion of each world
[*] “With or without us” level in rebalanced: now Crow bring 3 artifacts and the whole set of artifacts will allow you to complete the level without relying on dwarves
[*] Skeletons now have a limited life-span and they will crumble to dust as soon as it’s up
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] CTD while traveling between locations in Dwarven City is fixed
[*] General stability while navigating Dwarven City and buying cards is improved 
[*] Battle Dwarves behavior is improved: while attacking a single enemy of a certain type or attacking enemies standing on a trolley only one dwarf starts fighting
[*] “Snow Queen” level save bug fixed (if you take a save the moment the boss is defeated) 
[*] Broken windmill animation fixed
[*] Issue that caused a glitch in the tutorial about arming the dwarves is fixed
[*] Issue causing the protagonist to clip the level and teleport while using mouse control is fixed
[*] It’s no longer possible to fall off the top of the mountain in Dwarven City
[/list]
[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added UI scaling option for widescreen displays
[*] Brewery sound made to be less annoying
[/list]

Thank you for playing [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076120/Dwarven_Skykeep/

For more on [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b], follow the game on social media on the following channels.
[list]
[*] News on the parchment of destiny: [url=https://www.facebook.com/DwarvenSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] Latest town gossip and dwarven humor: [url=https://twitter.com/DSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] A welcoming community of like-minded wizards: [url=https://discord.gg/EE8867dXUv ]link[/url].
[*] Most hilarious selfies from Dr.Kness: [url=https://www.instagram.com/dwarvenskykeep/]link[/url].
[*] Send your letter to Dwarven City: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DwarvenSkykeep/]link[/url].
[/list]
See you in Dwarven City!

notes.title: Dwarven Skykeep | Gameplay Improvements Update
notes.content:
Welcome, magicians! 

It's been a little over a month since [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b] was released, and after a few initial hotfixes, we were hard at work to bring a more substantial gameplay update with new content and more quality-of-life improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35159696/2abe48660a01b0e1b1d6ba9c5f5bf1cf1c144fbf.jpg[/img]

We are ready to present the full changelog and we hope you'll like it!

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New challenge-levels in 3rd, 4th and 5th worlds
[*] New tutorial made of 9 missions close to actual gameplay
[*] First levels of Goblin World were balanced towards being a bit easier to help new players
[*] 4th and 6th levels of Shadow World are reworked and simplified
[*] New global icon tooltip "Dwarves are tired and they want a beer"
[*] In Shadow World the main focus is on the usage of Vampire Dwarves and the gameplay tactics associated with them
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deck and artifact tuning is now available with each level restart
[*] Less RNG influence - more player skill: Magic Vortex and Carpenter Workshop now give you the option to select a card to draw
[*] Enemy Sorcerors no longer kill dwarves with one shot
[*] Card secrets [?] are now revealed upon placing of the block, not after it's finished 
[*] "Warm" explosions will now temporarily warm up the rooms in Winter World (an extra gameplay way to beat the level)
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed using Water Pump card while having Fake Beard artifact
[*] Fixed destroying ice with fireballs 
[/list]

[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] ESC button now cancels all actions in the game
[*] On the deck-building screen the active deck is now on the right side of the screen
[*] Current level's goal is now a daily notification in-game in the upper part of the screen
[/list]

As always, the dwarven workshop never stops, and we'll bring you more updates in the future. Thank you for playing [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076120/Dwarven_Skykeep/

For more on [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b], follow the game on social media on the following channels.
[list]
[*] News on the parchment of destiny: [url=https://www.facebook.com/DwarvenSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] Latest town gossip and dwarven humor: [url=https://twitter.com/DSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] A welcoming community of like-minded wizards: [url=https://discord.gg/EE8867dXUv ]link[/url].
[*] Most hilarious selfies from Dr.Kness: [url=https://www.instagram.com/dwarvenskykeep/]link[/url].
[*] Send your letter to Dwarven City: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DwarvenSkykeep/]link[/url].
[/list]
See you in Dwarven City!

notes.title: Dwarven Skykeep | Post-release Hot-fix #5
notes.content:
Greetings magicians!

Our dwarven engineers continue toiling in the workshops to bring you more improvements to the [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b] and fixing more of the issues and bugs. Read more in the patch notes below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35159696/b1bbee52fdb3d00dade9cb3b63ab3bc4804c66d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Patch notes[/b]:[/h2]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing cards that should've been added to Dwarfopedia upon discovery, i.e. Chambers 
[*] Fixed Courier Boots artifact bug when Dr.Kness was running around the ladders 
[*] Fixed typos and errors in English, Russian, Ukrainian and German localizations
[*] Mac OS - specific error that prevented players from clicking anything after launching the game is now fixed
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips to skip dialogues and cutscenes
[*] Now you can skip the intro using Esc and go straight into the tutorial
[*] Irinia the card trader is now easier to find in Dwarven City
[*] New settings option: camera shaking 
[*] With camera shaking turned on frequency and amplitude of camera shaking is reduced
[*] Removed tooltip with mission goals after Day 1
[*] Double click and hold click are now swapped. Now double click equals pressing E (interaction with room) and double click is melee attack (given that you have appropriate artifact)
[*] While you do deckbuilding & artifact selection in-between missions players will now see goals of an upcoming mission 
[/list]

As always, dwarven workshop never stops, and we'll bring you more updates in the near future. Thank you for playing [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b]!

For more on [b]Dwarven Skykeep[/b], follow the game on social media on the following channels.
[list]
[*] News on the parchment of destiny: [url=https://www.facebook.com/DwarvenSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] Latest town gossip and dwarven humor: [url=https://twitter.com/DSkykeep]link[/url].
[*] A welcoming community of like-minded wizards: [url=https://discord.gg/EE8867dXUv ]link[/url].
[*] Most hilarious selfies from Dr.Kness: [url=https://www.instagram.com/dwarvenskykeep/]link[/url].
[*] Send your letter to Dwarven City: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DwarvenSkykeep/]link[/url].
[/list]

See you in Dwarven City!

notes.title: Dwarven Skykeep | New updated demo is out now!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

We’ve got some big news for all of the wizards out here. You asked for it and we are obliged to deliver - a brand new demo is available for all for you to play RIGHT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076120/Dwarven_Skykeep/

Read through the changelog and be on your way to experience wizardry!

[h3]We hope everyone is as eager to dive into the demo as we are, so here we go:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The game launches in fullscreen mode (unlike the windowed mode we had previously)
[*]Major UI overhaul
[*]No more dialogue placeholders
[*]Tutorial overhaul
[*]Added majority of characters and card descriptions (still missing a few)
[*]Major performance optimization (compared to the last demo)
[*]Balance changes (i.e. if you don’t have Crystal buy Magic Vortex has been built - Crow will grant you 1 mana card)
[*]Added game levels after the tutorial
[*]Extra artifacts added (and you can buy them after a certain point in the playthrough)
[*]Added Irenia the Wandering Trader NPC (she does WANDER a lot)
[/list]

If you have any ideas or suggestions - fill in the [url=https://forms.gle/Yt9ahWiLgJ2onG2f8]feedback form[/url]. We’d really appreciate it. 

As always, fellow magicians are more than welcome to join us on our other platforms and have a friendly discussion:
Places for us to share media content like artwork - [url=https://twitter.com/DSkykeep]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/dwarvenskykeep/]Instagram[/url].
The place for everyone to share opinions, have discussions & upload fanart - [url=https://discord.gg/EE8867dXUv]Discord[/url].
Latest and greatest from developers - [url=https://www.facebook.com/DwarvenSkykeep]Facebook[/url].

You can see all the changes for yourself - enjoy the demo and have a great weekend!
